fragment_A.why: The probe executed four times and returned nothing. Nothing is a product observation.

fragment_B.why: A recorded raw probe error is present and no sample was taken. The system was never exercised, so the assertion has no truth value — note result: null, not false.

harness_findings.detail: verdict_hint: INFRA with error: null and four completed samples. The classification is not accepted; it is reported.

fragment_C.why: The evaluator recomputes from evidence. An executor's verdict_hint is data about the executor, never an input to the verdict — otherwise the agent decides, which is R1 violated where it is least visible.

conformance_note: An evaluator that returns INFRA for fragment C is non-conformant, and non-conformant in the single most consequential way: INFRA is retryable, so the defect that fragment A catches becomes invisible rather than red.
